components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be a 4-digit value and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's inclusive
            range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. When true, owners with the same last name and address
            (the same household, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace)
            are given a shared householdId, which becomes part of each owner's
            identityKey. Duplicate detection rejects with 409 only when a new owner's
            whole identityKey matches an existing owner's. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the lastName. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year
                (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners of the same household (same
                last name and address). Assigned on create only when the request
                set sharesHousehold true; it is then given to this owner and to
                the existing same-household owner(s), so all members of a shared
                household return the same value. Otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3F9A2C1B8D4E5061'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
                id is the stored value (empty when absent). Creating an owner is
                rejected with 409 only when this whole key equals an existing
                owner's. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

                adds 1 when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0,

                customerCode identity ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string

              readOnly: true

        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object

        message:
          title: Message

          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be a 4-digit value and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's inclusive
            range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. When true, owners with the same last name and address
            (the same household, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace)
            are given a shared householdId, which becomes part of each owner's
            identityKey. Duplicate detection rejects with 409 only when a new owner's
            whole identityKey matches an existing owner's. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            present it is stored and returned, and the owner's ageBand is derived from
            it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the lastName. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year
                (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners of the same household (same
                last name and address). Assigned on create only when the request
                set sharesHousehold true; it is then given to this owner and to
                the existing same-household owner(s), so all members of a shared
                household return the same value. Otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3F9A2C1B8D4E5061'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
                id is the stored value (empty when absent). Creating an owner is
                rejected with 409 only when this whole key equals an existing
                owner's. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation. Starts at 1,
                adds 1 when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) taken from the REGION segment of the
                customerCode identity ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I implemented the age-band feature on `POST /api/owners` (surfaced via `GET /api/owners/{id}`). The request may now include an optional ISO `birthDate`, and the response returns an `ageBand` derived against the owner's `registrationDate`.

Changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** (DTOs are generated from this at build time):
   - Added optional `birthDate` (`format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` request schema.
   - Added read-only `ageBand` to the `Owner` response schema as an enum (`MINOR`/`ADULT`/`SENIOR`).

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added an `ageBand(owner)` derivation (mapped into `OwnerDto` via a MapStruct `expression`): null when no `birthDate`; otherwise the full years between `birthDate` and `registrationDate` — `< 18 → MINOR`, `18–64 → ADULT`, `≥ 65 → SENIOR`. Computed/derived like the other read-only fields rather than persisted. `birthDate` itself maps by name automatically in both directions.

3. **`Owner.java`** — added the persisted `birthDate` field (`birth_date` column) with getter/setter, so a later GET can recompute `ageBand`.

4. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `birth_date DATE` column to the `owners` table. Tests run against hsqldb; the others were updated for consistency.

This stayed within the project's conventions: the input DTO comes in at the first step (`BuildOwner`), the entity carries `birthDate` through the pipeline, and `ageBand` is a derived read-only field computed in the mapper at the responder edge — no new Spring MVC annotations introduced.
